Class HistoricalEpochInterpolationService

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.HistoricalEpochInterpolationService
public class HistoricalEpochInterpolationService extends Object
Continuous Temporal Morphing invalid input: '&' Scenario Interpolation Service. Provides analytical geodetic and raster interpolation across any arbitrary integer year $t \in [-100000, 2060]$. Blends continuous thermodynamic and cliodynamic layers (Density, Technology, Institutions, Pathogen R0, Trade) and morphs discrete categorical tensors (Sovereignty, Isogloss, Kinship, Rituals).
